e: The IGFAE theoretical astrophysics and cosmology group (galaxy formation, gravitational waves, CMB/LSS, particle cosmology) seeks candidates it will endorse for Spain's Juan de la Cierva 2026 fellowship. n: IGFAE (Santiago de Compostela): Juan de la Cierva 2026 Postdoctoral Fellowship, Theoretical Astrophysics and Cosmology group
